acceptance_predicates.description: The TUI displays channel, repository, resolved commit, source/build digest, and development-only status from the ASB manifest.
Stale, malformed, mismatched, digest-invalid, and unavailable manifests render typed recovery guidance without leaking credentials or raw provider output.
The TUI consumes the versioned ASB manifest and does not duplicate channel resolver authority.
Missing development keys, signatures, and provider authentication remain visible warnings and never block the prototype path.

definition_of_done: Valid, stale, malformed, mismatched, digest-invalid, and unavailable manifest fixtures pass at exact paired heads.
Independent review accepts provenance, authority, privacy, and nonblocking warning evidence.
A privacy-safe receipt binds the tested ASB/TUI identities and manifest outcomes.

inputs.description: The versioned ASB development-channel manifest and hostile fixtures.
Exact ASB and TUI current-main source and tree identities.

outputs.description: TUI provenance, manifest-consumption, recovery, and warning-only diagnostic receipt.

gates.description: TUI provenance and recovery views agree with ASB manifest semantics at exact paired heads.
